key_concepts: Robert Hooke first used the term cells in 1665 after observing cork
Anton Van Leeuwenhoek first observed microscopic organisms like protozoa and bacteria
Matthias Schleiden concluded all plants are composed of cells
Theodor Schwann theorized all animals are composed of cells
Rudolf Virchow stated cells come from pre-existing cells
The cell theory states all living things are made of cells
Cells are the basic structural and functional units of life
Organisms may be unicellular or multicellular
Cells are composed mainly of water along with proteins, RNA, DNA, and organelles
